summary: Added __eq__ and __hash__ methods to Todo class for comparison and set operations

verification.ruff_command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/ tests/

implementation_notes: Added eq=False to @dataclass decorator to disable default comparison
Implemented __eq__ to compare id, text, and done (excluding timestamps)
Implemented __hash__ based on same fields as __eq__ for consistency
This allows Todo objects to be used in sets and as dict keys
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='a') returns True
Todo objects can be placed in set() and correctly deduplicated
risks: Mutating todo fields after hashing can break set/dict invariants - this is an existing issue with mutable dataclasses
